rationale: The text primarily describes license entitlement and lists security-feature names without explaining their functions. It does explicitly state that telemetry can be turned off, but this limited setting alone leaves the conventional functionality only weakly established; best forced binary choice is non-AI.
evidence_spans: The E3 subscription is required to elevate the Windows Pro License to a Windows Enterprise License; Windows Enterprise is required for use of many of the security features of Windows; Bitlocker Mgmt; App Locker; Device Guard; Credential Guard;  Telemetry can be turned Off,  etc
conflict_response: I do not interpret the feature names as evidence of disk encryption, application lockdown, or credential/device-protection mechanisms. The source explicitly gives a license entitlement and says telemetry can be turned off; that provides a narrow concrete setting, but the remaining list is unexplained names, so support is weak/forced rather than a fully supported negative.
